title: PersisterConfig
subtitle: Configuration options for persisters
description: Configuration interface for creating persister instances. Defines storage backend, serialization options, and cache management settings.

rows.name: burstKey
rows.description: Version key to invalidate old cached data when breaking changes occur.

rows.name: prefix
rows.description: Prefix for storage keys to avoid conflicts with other applications.

rows.name: debounceTime
rows.description: Time in milliseconds to debounce save operations for performance.

behavior.title: Flexible
behavior.description: Supports various storage backends and configurations

dos: Use appropriate storage backend for your use case
Use custom serialization for complex data types
donts: Don't store sensitive data in localStorage
Don't set maxAge too high for frequently changing data
Don't forget to handle storage quota exceeded errors
